connector.name: Rachio MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Rachio sprinkler controllers - schedules, zones, and live watering control
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package rachio-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rwestergren account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: RACHIO_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: Long-lived Rachio OAuth access token. Mint one with `rachio-mcp-token` (or `uvx --from rachio-mcp rachio-mcp-token`). The token lasts ~25 years and replaces sending your password to the MCP process.
